blocks.text: CFO Search: Roach, Moss and Hall
A retained search for the next Chief Financial Officer of {{fact:f:E-2015-001.client}}, prepared for the hiring committee by our search team.
What we set out to do

items: Find a Chief Financial Officer who can carry the finance function through the company's next stage of growth, not simply keep its books.
Run the search on a retained basis, working only for {{fact:f:E-2015-001.client}} on this mandate until the seat is filled.
Protect discretion throughout, describing candidates by their current role and record rather than by name until both sides are ready to meet.
The engagement opened on {{fact:f:E-2015-001.start}}, and the position specification has been agreed with Jason Myers and the board, so the whole team is now searching against one settled brief.
James Grant has begun mapping the market at the senior-operator level, covering the sectors where a CFO of this profile is likely to be found, and is building the long list from that map.
Jeffrey Patterson has opened the first candidate conversations and is keeping every thread moving, so that no promising prospect goes quiet while the field is still coming together.
Sandra Fuentes, Principal, leads the assignment and owns the relationship with the committee and with every candidate.
James Grant, Senior Consultant, works the market at the most senior level and weighs the finalists.
Jeffrey Patterson, Research Consultant, runs the candidate threads and keeps the search on schedule.
Complete the market map and close the long list over the coming weeks.
Begin first-round interviews and assessment as strong prospects confirm their interest.
Report progress to Jason Myers at our standing check-in, and bring the committee a short slate once the field has been tested.
